main_text.l: צָפִיר m. Hircus, Dan.8.5. Constr. צְפִיר v.5. Plur. Constr. צְפִירֵי עִזִּים Hircos caprarum, Esr.8.35. Chald. וּצְפִירֵי עִזָּיִן Et hircos caprarum, Esr.6.17.

צְפִירָה f. Matutinum tempus, Ezech.7.10. ex Chaldaeo, ubi צְפַר vel צְפָרָא Mane: item, Cidaris, Diadema: unde Constr. וּלְצְפִירַת תִּפְאָרָה Et pro cidari decoris, Jesa.28.5. à Cingendo, Verbi significatione Chaldaica.

צִפָּרֶן m. Unguis, Ungula: Metaphoricè, Stylus, Scalprum, ferramentum quo lapides caeduntur & veluti sculpuntur: בְּצִפָּרֶן שָׁמִיר Scalpro lapidis servabilis, seu diuturni, aut, Stylo adamantis, Jer.17.1. Plur. cum Aff. צִפָּרְנֵיהֶם Ungues suos, Deut.21.12.
צְפַרְדֵּעַ c. Rana, Ranae, collectivè, Exod.8.6. Plur. צְפַרְדְּעִים Ranas, v.3.
צִקְלוֹן m. Gluma, folliculus grani frumentarii: Aff. בְּצִקְלוֹנוֹ Cum gluma sua, 2.Reg.4.4.2.
נִצְרַב Niph. Aduftus fuit: Praeter. וְנִצְרְבוּ־בָהּ Et adurentur in ea, Ezech.20.4.7.
צָרְבָנִית f. Adurens, Prov.16.27. Nomen Toar, forma קִשְׁבָּת Attenta: Item Aduftio, juxta Kimchium, Lev.13.23. At secundum R.Salom. est Cicatrix aduftionis.
צְרִי, צָרִי m. Opobalsamum, Gen.37.25. Jer.51. v.8. A Judaeis in versione Hebraeo-germanica Pentateuchi Theriaca redditur.
צָרַח Clamavit: Part. מַר צָרֵחַ Amare clamat, Soph.1. v.14. Hiph. יָצְרִיחַ Exclamat, Jes.42.13.

צְרִיחַ m. Arx, Propugnaculum, Turris munita; sic dicta, quòd speculator inde Exclamat, scribit Kimchi: אֶל־צְרִיחַ In arcem & propugnaculum, Jud.9.46. Plur. וּבַצְּרִיחִים Et in arcibus vel turribus, 1.Sam.13.6.

page.notes: Doubtful readings: the running head Hebrew letters, the Hebrew in the entry with "* צִפֹּרֶת" and several vowel points and Hebrew forms in the entries were read from a small, low-contrast scan and may not be exact; the Hebrew marks [?] are not all placed inline. The Hebrew after "Ezech.7.10" and "Diadema: unde" and the first entry's "Plur. Constr." line are the least certain. The large letters צ and צר at the left are entry letters, not headings. The printed "Efr" and "Jefa" are read as Esr and Jesa, which appear to be OCR-like misprints of the scan's long s; the printed form is left in the reference "Jefa.28.5" as it is in the original. No printing error has been corrected in the Latin.
